scope: Independent training-source development seeds only: same prior, real associations and tracker pose. No held-source rendering, Blender, oracle candidate, policy training, new calibration or formal gate.

bodyparts3d_left_mirrored.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

medseg_right.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

shared_geometry_provenance.coordinate_frame: neutral SMPL-X world XYZ mm; y is longitudinal

provenance.tape_sha256: agps-step3r-tracking-tape-v1: public controls and anonymous echoes plus offline pose, role centers, acquisition height, contributor masks and ghosts

old_whole_segment_verifier.candidate_use: same old verifier decision rules, not independent calibration or coverage evidence

schedule.seed_derivation: first 8 SHA-256 bytes (big endian) of recorded episode_id

station.metric_scope: Raw nearest native rows (ties lower, no gap fill); first frame with independent clean lumen echoes for the complete request. Whole-segment verifier uses all four online estimates. Frozen development readouts are descriptive; neither was refitted.
station.timing_scope: Local wall-clock per actual uninstrumented online step; alternating first arm by tape and frame. Includes online scoring, excludes rendering, reset, I/O and audit. Not formal latency.

schedule.seed_derivation: SeedSequence([root_seed, source_index, tape_index]).generate_state(1, dtype=uint64)[0]; both indices are zero-based

dynamic.metric_scope: Real/tracker for both; truth only for scoring and passive stage tracing. Every rendered role/frame counts even without geometry; complete RMSE is null if any role is missing or no lumen rendered. Joint success requires every exact mask representable and correct, and every rendered center measured with world error <6 mm on a tape with lumen.

decision.rule: At least one pooled downstream joint count must improve; none of the pooled downstream counts or geometry measured counts on fixed opportunities may decrease. Search survival, conditional RMSE and readout F1 are descriptive only.
